SELECT A.REG_CODE as prdRegistCode, A.ACCOUNT as prodId, NVL(A.AGENCY_CODE,A.REGIST_BANK_CODE) as institutionCode, A.FUND_ACC_PLACE as areaCode, B.HOLDER_TYPE as holderType, A.CCY as ccy, A.IS_CONSIGN as isagency, NVL((select sum(AMOUNT) FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14')),0) as daySaleAmountSum, NVL((NVL((select sum(AMOUNT) FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14')),0) - NVL((select sum(AMOUNT) FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE BUSI_TYPE in ('03','16','15')),0)),0) as dayValueAmountSum, A.PROD_VALUE as prodValue, NVL((select sum(AMOUNT) FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14')),0) as daySaleQtySum, NVL((NVL((select sum(AMOUNT) FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14')),0) - NVL((select sum(AMOUNT) FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE BUSI_TYPE in ('03','16','15')),0)),0) as dayValueQtySum, NVL((select sum(AMOUNT) FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14')),0) * A.PROD_VALUE as saleTotalByQty, NVL((NVL((select sum(AMOUNT) FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14')),0) - NVL((select sum(AMOUNT) FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE BUSI_TYPE in ('03','16','15')),0)),0) * A.PROD_VALUE as valueTotalByQty, to_date(#{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') as equityConfDate FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB A left join ( SELECT DISTINCT(INDENTIFY_MARK), ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK, REGIST_BANK_CODE, HOLDER_TYPE FROM( SELECT INDENTIFY_MARK, ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK, REGIST_BANK_CODE, CASE HOLDER_CLASSIFY when '01' THEN decode(HOLDER_TYPE,'01','01','02','01','03','01') when '02' THEN decode(HOLDER_TYPE,'01','02','02','02','03','02') ELSE decode(HOLDER_TYPE,'04','03','05','04','06','05','07','06','08','07','09','08','10','09','11','99','12','99','13','99','14','99','15','99','16','99','17','10', '18','10','19','10','20','10','21','10','22','10','23','10','24','99','25','99','99') END as HOLDER_TYPE FROM CHB_EQU_SUB
union ALL
SELECT INDENTIFY_MARK, ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK, REGIST_BANK_CODE, CASE HOLDER_CLASSIFY when '01' THEN decode(HOLDER_TYPE,'01','01','02','01','03','01') when '02' THEN decode(HOLDER_TYPE,'01','02','02','02','03','02') ELSE decode(HOLDER_TYPE,'04','03','05','04','06','05','07','06','08','07','09','08','10','09','11','99','12','99','13','99','14','99','15','99','16','99','17','10', '18','10','19','10','20','10','21','10','22','10','23','10','24','99','25','99','99') END as HOLDER_TYPE FROM CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK ) ) B on A.ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK WHERE TO_CHAR(A.EQUITY_CONF_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY A.REG_CODE,NVL(A.AGENCY_CODE,A.REGIST_BANK_CODE),A.FUND_ACC_PLACE,B.HOLDER_TYPE,A.CCY,A.FUND_ACC_PLACE,A.IS_CONSIGN,A.PROD_VALUE,A.ACCOUNT,A.EQUITY_CONF_DATE
mapper.insert: insert into CHB_SALE_DEAL_SUM(PRD_REGIST_CODE, PROD_ID, INSTITUTION_CODE, AREA_CODE, HOLDER_TYPE, CCY, ISAGENCY, DAY_SALE_AMOUNT_SUM, DAY_VALUE_AMOUNT_SUM, PROD_VALUE, DAY_SALE_QTY_SUM, DAY_VALUE_QTY_SUM,SALE_TOTAL_BY_QTY, VALUE_TOTAL_BY_QTY,REMARK, CREATE_USER, ORG_CODE, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, EQUITY_CONF_DATE) values( #{prdRegistCode},#{prodId},#{institutionCode},#{areaCode}, #{holderType}, #{ccy},#{isagency}, #{daySaleAmountSum}, #{dayValueAmountSum}, #{prodValue}, #{daySaleQtySum},#{dayValueQtySum},#{saleTotalByQty},#{valueTotalByQty}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate,#{updateUser},sysdate,to_date(#{equityConfDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) from CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE TO_CHAR(EQUITY_CONF_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
